summary: Sprint B (Áreas Curriculares scope-por-grado) tested end-to-end. Backend: 12/13 pytest cases passed (1 skipped — consolidated endpoint requires section discovery). Frontend E2E: login + double-accordion (Grade->Subject) + sub-modal with shortcuts + individual checkbox toggle all work as expected. No regressions found.
critical_code_review_comments: Shortcut keys use format `level:<uuid>` and `sec_first_<uuid>` / `sec_last_<uuid>` — the review_request task description mentioned `level-XX` but the actual implementation uses colon-prefixed UUIDs. The frontend handles them correctly. Just note the discrepancy in docs.
POST /unlink with `group_keys` + `grade_ids` correctly scopes only matching instances; `total_instances_affected` is consistent with `unlinked_count`.
GET /subjects?page_size=500 correctly returns 422 (validation), and frontend now sends 200 — verified bug fix from main agent works.
_load_school_grade_index uses dict for grades_by_id and assumes nivel exists; if a grade points to a non-existent level it falls back to defaults (order=999) — safe.
Round-trip link/unlink preserved data; production data not altered after test run.
test_credentials: admin@elroble.edu / 1234abc8 (used). Login form is at /elroble/login (school-scoped). Direct /login redirects but does not auto-fill — use school-scoped URL.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing 'Matemática' area with 17 instances spanning Inicial/Primaria buckets. Round-trip unlink+link returned data to original state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_curricular_areas_sprint_b.py and cover: grade-shortcuts shape, area-subjects breakdown, page_size=200 limit, page_size>200 → 422, available-subjects grade_ids filter, link/unlink round-trip scoped-by-grade, legacy subject_ids path. Reusable for future regression. Frontend selectors verified: expand-area-<id>, grade-bucket-<key>, open-link-submodal-btn, link-submodal, grade-shortcut-<key>, toggle-individual-grades, grade-checkbox-<id>. School elroble has levels Inicial (3,4,5 años), Primaria (1°-6°), Secundaria (1°-4°) — note only 4 secundaria grades, not 5; sec_last shortcut still appears with just 4°.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs reproduced. Both prior fixes by main agent (page_size=200 cap; errMsg helper for 422 array detail) verified working: 200 succeeds, 500 returns 422 cleanly, frontend renders without ErrorBoundary crash.
